continuityBible: Taipei, 2026. The main event runs from 16:40 to 17:20 on one rainy workday. The company has already eliminated Lin Yu-cheng's position after losing its largest client; this is not performance action and cannot be reversed in the meeting. Zhou Yu-an remains Lin's manager during the notification and must not seek forgiveness, romance, physical intimacy or emotional reassurance. HR partner Zeng Ya-lin represents the company, previously benefited from silence in a similar meeting, and now refuses to let silence be recorded as consent. Only the true ending reaches three weeks later, after every employment, equipment, portfolio and recommendation process has ended and Lin initiates private contact.
